name: Loot Scale
description: More (or fewer) materials per loot stack: chests, enemy loot, things on the ground, plants and bushes you pick, trees you chop and rocks you mine, on top of the world's own Loot Amount setting. Nothing is saved into the world. In a game you host it applies to every player (not tested on a dedicated server).

settings.label: Loot amount factor
settings.help: Chests, enemy loot and things you pick up from the ground. The three below follow it unless you set them.

settings.label: Picking plants and bushes
settings.help: Berries, flax, crops and other plants you pick with E. 0 = the same as the loot amount factor.

settings.label: Chopping trees
settings.help: Wood and what else trees and woody bushes drop when you hit them. 0 = the same as the loot amount factor.

settings.label: Mining rocks
settings.help: Stone, ore and minerals from rocks and veins you hit. 0 = the same as the loot amount factor.
